text:
sre-bot: [PAGER] High error rate detected for inference-hosted us-east-1a (az1a). 95th latency > 2.5s, spike in ECONNRESET/502 from gRPC pools. Autoscaling not recovering fast enough. Alert ID: INFR-20260315-01 :rotating_light:
ash: ack, I'm on it. tagging @marta @liam for network/runtime visibility.
marta: joining. grabbing metrics and perf traces. can you post the instance IDs / target group?
ash: quick view: NLB tg-inference-us-east-1a showing 12/48 unhealthy, error 502 and connection resets. Instances show kernel rx_ring drops in dmesg.
liam: oncall-runtime here. possible NIC driver regressions? any recent kernel updates deployed to az1a?
ash: no scheduled infra deploys in last 24h. I see a pattern: rx_queue_overflow, softirq latency elevated. sample dmesg: ```[1739987654.123] eth0: RX: dropped packet, rx-dropped=1280```.
marta: can you run ethtool -S on a sample host? also check eni queue stats and instance syslogs.
ash: running: ```ssh ec2-user@10.0.12.45 sudo ethtool -S eth0 | grep rx_``` output: ```rx_errors: 432, rx_dropped: 1280, rx_fifo_errors: 0```. have a few hosts with high rx_dropped.
liam: thanks. looks like host-level RX queue saturation. immediate mitigations: 1) drain targets in us-east-1a, 2) shift traffic to other AZs, 3) reduce per-request concurrency to lower packetization pressure.
ash: initiating target group deregistration for 6 most-impacted hosts (tg-dreg -t host:10.0.12.[45,46,47,48,49,50]) -> running deregistration. deploy-bot: deregister jobs kicked.
deploy-bot: deregistration commands executed, showing draining state, connections draining grace 300s.
marta: changing NLB cross-zone load balancing weight isn't available, but we can increase target weights in ALB listener rules (route traffic away) and update service routing policy to prefer us-east-1b/c. doing that now.
eng-runtime: runtime note: when hosts are drained, KV cache miss rate will spike. enabling soft-fallback to reduced-prefix caching to lower K/V memory pressure. patch applied to runtime config: ```kvcache.prefix_heuristic: reduced```
ash: also bumping autoscaling desired capacity in other AZs by +4 to absorb load: ```aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name inference-us-east --desired-capacity 72```
liam: good. can we also lower nginx keepalive timeout on fronting proxies to free socket resources quicker?
marta: lowering keepalive to 15s across proxy fleet. patch rolling.
eva-cs: cs/ops: which customers can see errors? running quick query against /usage to find active tenants hitting us-east-1a.
ash: quick sample: customers A (prod-high), B (staging), C (analytics) had ~4-7% of requests routed to affected hosts in last 10m. overall impact ~3-6% error rate for requests pinned to us-east-1a.
eva-cs: notified A and C via priority channel, providing workaround: force region fallback to us-east-1b by specifying region header for now.
liam: temporary routing policy we applied should steer new sessions away; sticky sessions may still hit drained hosts until TTL expires. reducing session affinity TTL on NLB to 30s to speed churn.
marta: update to status page: "Investigating: increased error rate for inference in us-east-1 impacting a subset of requests. Working on mitigation (traffic steering and instance drains)." ETA for next update 15m.
nash: monitoring: errors dropping from 5.2% -> 1.1% after drains and ASG bump. latency 95th down from 2.7s -> 1.1s. KV miss spike observed but acceptable.
liam: marking mitigation in place. we should still keep pagers active for 30m to ensure stability and to catch any regressions when drained hosts rejoin.
eng-runtime: plan for medium-term: replace NIC driver version on affected AMI, add rx-queue tuning (increase RPS/packets steering), and add hardware offload checks in node bootstrap. I'll open an action ticket.
eva-cs: customers updated. escalation: no major customer outages, some increased errors for a handful of tenants. CS severity: Sev2-> monitoring.
marta: oncall-handoff note: @ash will remain until 1739987800, then hand to @liam for night. postmortem owner assigned: @marta.
nash: handoff: logging known host IDs and actions in incident doc: hosts quarantined: i-0a12345..., i-0a12346..., i-0a12347...; drained at 1739987680.
liam: will follow up with kernel dmesg collection and coordinate with cloud provider ticket for possible hardware-level NIC egress/backplane problems.
nash: final note before handoff: keep routing policy enforced and do not re-register hosts until NIC counters back to baseline and a controlled reboot + kernel rollback test passes.
marta: thanks team. next update in 30m or sooner if regression. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: incident log entry created: INFR-20260315-01, mitigation_state: in_progress, owners: [ash,marta,liam], postmortem_owner: marta.
eva-cs: leaving follow-up messages for customers, will update status page when we transition to monitored/recovered.
liam: last check at 1739987890: error rate steady ~0.9%, no new rx_dropped growth on active hosts. closing immediate pager; keeping incident channel open for postmortem and RCA data.
